title: draw_messages allocates all message Lines on every 50ms tick
description: ui.rs draw_messages collects ALL messages into Vec<Line> on every redraw (lines 98-100) before passing to Paragraph with a scroll offset. With 500 messages only ~20 are visible but all 500 are allocated and formatted on every 50ms tick. Fix: slice the deque to [top..top+visible_height] and only format visible lines.
